prose: Emily Ridout is an astrologer, folklorist and master yogini, who's been a frequent returning guest for InnerVerse. Combining her multiple disciplines, Emily not only reads your sky-clock chart, she combines that wisdom with your unique physiology by prescribing movement practices that are perfect for your planetary placements. Today we're going live with this Astro-Yoga guru to talk about 2021 and 2022.
